name: elgg-plugin-fleet
description: Migration matrix for a fleet of Elgg plugins across major versions. Creates one issue per plugin per version step with proper dependencies.

plugins_dir.description: Path to the directory containing plugin repos

instructions: This formula is dynamic — it scans {{plugins_dir}} to discover plugins and their current versions, then creates issues only for the migration steps that are needed. Run the scan step first, then create issues based on the matrix output.

steps.title: Scan: inventory plugins in {{plugins_dir}} and build migration matrix
steps.description: For each plugin in {{plugins_dir}}: (1) Detect current version from git branches, elgg-plugin.php, start.php, manifest.xml. (2) Check for existing migrate/elgg-* branches. (3) Check upstream GitHub for forks and branches with migrations. (4) Check Packagist for upgraded versions. (5) Output a matrix: plugin × version step with status (done/todo/skip/upstream). This step does NOT create migration issues — it produces the matrix for review.

steps.title: Create beads issues for all 'todo' cells in the migration matrix
steps.description:
For each 'todo' cell in the matrix, create beads issues with a full dependency chain per plugin:

1. Create a pre-migration test issue (P0): 'Add pre-migration tests: <plugin>'
2. Create migration issues (P2) for each version step: 'Migrate <plugin> <from>→<to>'
3. Wire dependencies:
   - Pre-migration test → blocks → first migration step (e.g., tests → 3.x→4.x)
   - Each migration step → blocks → next step (e.g., 3.x→4.x → 4.x→5.x)
   - If the plugin starts at 4.x (no 3→4 needed), pre-migration test → blocks → 4.x→5.x directly

4. EVERY migration issue MUST have full acceptance criteria set via --acceptance flag. Use this template (substituting <plugin> and <TARGET>):

  GATE 1: Pre-migration tests passing on current version (use elgg-test-writer skill)
  GATE 2: Migration branch created (migrate/elgg-<TARGET>.x)
  GATE 3: Automated rules applied (bin/migrate.php --verify --security)
  GATE 4: LLM-guided manual fixes applied — zero warnings in report
  GATE 5: PHP syntax check clean (php -l on all .php files, exclude vendor/)
  GATE 6: PostMigrationVerifier passes (no future-version API leakage)
  GATE 7: SecuritySweep passes (no critical findings)
  GATE 8: Pre-migration tests adapted and passing on TARGET version
  GATE 9: Plugin activates in elgg<TARGET> Docker container
  GATE 10: Site renders HTTP 200 with >1000 bytes (homepage AND login route)
  GATE 11: PHP_CodeSniffer passes for target version standards
  GATE 12: ARCHITECTURE.md generated
  GATE 13: CHANGELOG.md updated
  GATE 14: Elgg\Upgrade\Batch script added if data migration needed
  GATE 15: Commit follows format: migrate(<TARGET>.x): <summary>
  GATE 16: All gates verified before bd close --reason

The issue description MUST include: 'Use the elgg-migrate skill. ALL 16 acceptance gates above are mandatory — see skills/elgg-migrate/SKILL.md "Beads Acceptance Criteria" section. A subagent dispatched on this issue MUST report on each gate explicitly.'

Naming conventions:
- Test issues: 'Add pre-migration tests: <plugin>'
- Migration issues: 'Migrate <plugin> <from>→<to>'

Use parallel subagents for bulk creation. After creating all issues, verify with 'bd blocked' that the chains are correct.

steps.title: Migrate: work through ready issues one version step at a time
steps.description: Pick issues from 'bd ready'. For each: (1) Run pre-flight checks (elgg-migrate Phase 1.5). (2) Execute migration (elgg-migrate Phase 2). (3) Document any learnings in the skill or manifest. (4) Close the issue. Repeat until all issues for the current version step are done, then advance to the next step.

steps.title: Review: update skills and manifests with learnings from this batch
steps.description: After each version step completes for all plugins: (1) Review bd memories for patterns. (2) Add new common mistakes to elgg-migrate/SKILL.md. (3) Add new rules to manifest.json if patterns repeat across 3+ plugins. (4) Update reference docs if new breaking changes discovered. (5) Commit skill/manifest changes to elgg-migrate repo.
